correctness.rationale: The 3×3 cell-order poset has precisely 42 linear extensions by the hook-length count 9!/8640. The event-degree/Walsh-degree spans agree because indicators and signs are related by affine linear transforms. Independent enumeration of all 42 linear extensions and event incidence produced exact rational Gram ranks (1,11,31,41,42), corroborated over mod2, for degrees 0 through 4. The proposed 24 signed tableaux are valid extensions formed by blocks of sizes 2,3,2; alternating signs cancel every event fixing <=3 entries because eliminating the alternating symmetry requires at least 1+2+1=4 fixed entries across blocks. Exactly one degree-three kernel direction follows from rank41. The exhibited four-entry event singles out one signed tableau and distinguishes the two twelve-point laws by 1/12; rank42 proves every law recovered by degree four. This is a complete finite proof, no extrapolation to other shapes.

Pittel–Romik give asymptotic limit shapes; ideal-lattice algorithms enumerate linear extensions. None yields the all-distributions graded rank hierarchy on the fixed 3×3 square.

Resultary finds analogues for Latin squares/Shidoku but not a prior stronger 3×3 tableaux statement.
